description: This C# source file defines a REST API controller named SystemController that handles various system-related endpoints such as health checks, exportable items listing, custom field management, and system usage reporting within an ASP.NET Core project. It includes auxiliary classes for exportable items registration and multiple endpoints for CRUD operations and health status validation.

classes.name: ExportableItem
classes.description: Represents an item that can be exported, including a key, description, and an optional class type.

classes.name: ExportablesRegistry
classes.description: Static registry that holds a list of predefined exportable items such as audit logs, commands, documents, etc.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of custom fields with optional limit, returns as JSON.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new custom field entry in the database.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Performs health checks on file system, database, and Redis, returning their statuses.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the list of exportable items with their keys and descriptions.

methods.name: GetUsage
methods.description: Returns system usage data via injected service.
